name: customer-onboarding
description: Collect new customer details via form, gate on a kickoff go/no-go approval, then emit a structured onboarding checklist.

inputs.name: primary_contact
inputs.description: Primary contact name and email (e.g. Alice — alice@example.com)

steps.description: Customer Success lead must confirm the kickoff is ready to proceed.
steps.prompt: Review the new customer details collected in the previous step. Approve to confirm the kickoff is ready and begin onboarding, or reject if additional information is needed.

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  if (((."kickoff-approval".decision) // "reject") | tostring) == "approve" then
    "## Onboarding Checklist — " + ((."collect-customer".name // "New Customer") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Plan:** " + ((."collect-customer".plan // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Primary Contact:** " + ((."collect-customer".primary_contact // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Owner:** " + ((.inputs.owner // "Customer Success") | tostring) + "\n\n" +
    "### Tasks\n" +
    "- [ ] Send welcome email to primary contact\n" +
    "- [ ] Provision account and set plan: " + ((."collect-customer".plan // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "- [ ] Schedule kickoff call\n" +
    "- [ ] Share onboarding guide\n" +
    "- [ ] Set up Slack / support channel"
  else
    "## Onboarding NOT STARTED — kickoff rejected\n" +
    "**Customer:** " + ((."collect-customer".name // "New Customer") | tostring) + "\n" +
    "**Reason:** kickoff go/no-go was rejected; additional information required before onboarding.\n" +
    "No onboarding tasks generated."
  end
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{onboarding_checklist: .}'
